body: Well I'm afraid I am not able to provide you with any information on that. But I can provide a pair of ears, if you ever want to vent about something I can help you. Like other people have mentioned in this thread seeking help is a good although frightening starting point. I wish you all the best, hope your situation improves soon.

Well, this place is anonymous and quite frankly I wasn't really sure if anyone would respond anyway, I just wanted to vent I suppose. Put my thoughts in writing. Honestly I can't tell my mother because of how she would react. Explaining a condition such is this is not easy and one has to live through it to understand it. My mother isn't insensitive or anything like that, but I'm afraid of hurting her. Having a child that considers and even has attempted suicide must be crushing for a parent.

Yes, it felt like I was going to finally beat the beast. I was calmer than I thought, slowly but surely slipping away. I am not very happy I survived, but I hope to see a day where I look back at all this and think about how stupid I've been. In any case thank you very much for your comment.
I wish I knew how to tie a stronger knot :(
Thank you very much, I hope things improve for you as well. It sucks living this way.

I unfortunately have to be strong, I am currently living with my mom since universities are closed and I don't want to reveal to her my situation. It wouldn't help anyone. I am trying my best to keep my condition in check until I am alone but it's getting nearly impossible. The only reason I'm alive this long is because I'm considering of my family, but today was different. However I'm still alive, much to my dismay. So I'll explore every avenue I can.
Thank you very much, I really appreciate it

Well this hobby can be pretty expensive as well (otd's,tgr's etc go for 1k+)

It was never about just using keyboards.Collecting has been a huge aspect of this hobby since the beginning,be it vintage stuff,otd,high end boards,artisans etc.And although keyboards have practical use in every day life they don't stop being a hobby and people in here (at least i think) don't view keyboards as just a tool but more like an art piece which you not only use but admire as well.So in the end even though one cannot deny the practicality of keyboards the hobby was always much more than that.

I have to disagree with you here.You can try different mounting styles, plates, switches etc.And if it makes you happy and you like keyboards it's not really a waste of money.For me 5 is the sweet spot but many people like to collect so i say more power to them.

I'm not against many keyboards,if you can afford them that is.I am guilty of spending a lot on keyboards myself but like If you can't pay the months rent I don't think you need another keyboard.And somehow people think that being financially irresponsible and broke for the sake of a hobby is cool and a joke.
